name: DontRoundMyTimestamps
description: Always rounds relative timestamps down, so 7.6y becomes 7y instead of 8y
summary: Rounds relative timestamps down (7.6y shows as 7y, not 8y)
notes: Qord renders relative timestamps (<t:…:R>) with moment.js's rules, like Discord; this plugin switches its rounding to round down, as upstream does with moment.relativeTimeRounding(Math.floor).
